title: The Nihilist Reading Of Soul Eater: Monotone Princess #Shorts
description:
Every serious account of Soul Eater: Monotone Princess eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. Soul Eater (Japanese: ソウルイーター, Hepburn: Sōru Ītā) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Atsushi Ohkubo. Set at the "Death Weapon Meister Academy", the series revolves around three teams, each consisting of a weapon meister and at least one human that can transform into a weapon.

Nothing in Soul Eater: Monotone Princess was built for you — it was built for reproduction. It later aired on Adult Swim's Toonami programming block from February 17, 2013, to March 16, 2014. Six pieces of theme music are used for the episodes: two opening themes and four ending themes.
